A failed export creates a failure receipt and does not expose a partial artifact through the download screen. Retrying with the same request token resumes an unfinished job when possible. Retrying a completed export with a new request token produces a separate artifact whose retentio

nation that no longer exists. The incident record should distinguish revoked permission from an unavailable endpoint. Include the destination identifier rather than a credential-bearing URL in ordinary notes. Secret rotation, when required, follows the security handbook and should be recorded as a separate access-management event.

## KST-611 retention hold

KST-611 indicates that an erasure stage encountered an active retention hold. Inspect the project's retention panel to determine the hold type and issuing authority. The deletion request can remain pending while the hold is reviewed. An operator must not treat the code as a transient transport failure and repeatedly force the erasure stage.
